title: Singularity Physics
description: Event horizons, Hawking radiation and the Kugelblitz: a black hole made from light alone.

puzzle.goal: A probe falls straight towards a non-rotating mass M. In the curved spacetime outside it, the clock rate and radial distances are both modified by the factor (1 − rs/r). Write the normalisation of the four-velocity (dots are rates per unit of the probe's own time) for purely radial motion; the factor vanishes at the horizon.
puzzle.name: Schwarzschild metric (radial four-velocity normalisation)
puzzle.ask: The horizon radius is rs = 2GM/c². Find it, in km, for one solar mass.
puzzle.method: Proper time is the interval along the path. The time part is weighted by (1 − rs/r), the radial part by its inverse, with opposite signs.
